daily.today_energy: Your aura's giving main character energy today, Leo. The cosmos is basically handing you a spotlight—use it to shine on something that actually matters to you, not just what looks good.
daily.love: If you're vibing with someone, today's the day to drop the walls a little. Vulnerability hits different when you're genuinely being yourself. Single? Your energy's magnetic rn, so trust the universe's timing.
daily.career: Your ideas have serious potential to move things forward. Even if they feel half-baked, share them anyway—collaboration will polish them into something real. Your instincts are locked in today.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and sunlight. Whether it's a walk, stretching, or dancing in your room, your energy flows better when you're actually using it. Listen to what feels good, not what feels like a chore.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to lean into your authenticity, Leo. Mercury's movement brings clarity to situations that felt murky before. Trust your gut—it's been trying to tell you something.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering softly in your corner. Whether you're coupled or solo, this is about magnetic presence, not performance. Show up as yourself and watch how differently people respond.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas have serious potential right now. The universe is rewarding your willingness to take calculated risks. Document your wins this week—you'll want to reference them later.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for nourishment that actually feels good, not just looks good. Move in ways that bring joy, eat things that align with your energy. Listen to what your system genuinely needs.
